title: PluginRegistry
description: Dev-time plugin registry for portal-app-shell. Defines which plugins the Vite dev server should load, where to find their Module Federation manifests, and any custom overrides. Used by the Vite Express middleware to build a mock /api/meta response. In production, the Go backend serves /api/meta directly.

pluginEntry.description: A single plugin entry in the dev registry. Backward-compatible with the legacy {name, port, tunnelHost} format.

name.description: Plugin identifier. Must match the Go plugin ID or the build-time plugin.config.ts name. Used as the key in /api/meta plugins map.

port.description: Dev server port for this plugin's Module Federation remote entry. Required unless 'web_bundles' is provided.

tunnelHost.description: Hostname for tunnel-based remote dev (e.g. 'billing.tunnel.pinner.xyz'). When set, the manifest URL uses https://{tunnelHost}/mf-manifest.json instead of localhost.

tunnelProtocol.description: Protocol for tunnel connection. Defaults to https.

local.description: Marks this as a local-only plugin with no corresponding Go backend. The Vite middleware will inject this plugin into the /api/meta response even when the upstream server does not include it. Manifest URL is derived from port/tunnelHost using the same rules as Go plugins.

web_bundles.description: Explicit web bundle definitions. When omitted, defaults to a single bundle at {baseUrl}/mf-manifest.json. Use this for Go plugins that serve multiple bundles targeting different apps (e.g. dashboard vs admin views).

meta.description: Plugin-specific metadata merged into the /api/meta response for this plugin. Mirrors the Go PluginInfo.Meta callback.

build.description: Build information for this plugin, included in the /api/meta response.

webBundle.description: A single web bundle definition pointing to a Module Federation manifest.

manifestUrl.description: URL to the mf-manifest.json for this bundle. Can be a local dev server (http://localhost:PORT/mf-manifest.json), a tunnel URL, or an absolute URL to a deployed manifest.

targetApps.description: Which app types this bundle serves. Empty array or omitted = all apps. Mirrors the Go WebBundle.TargetApps field.
